set.body: Create docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md from a live cross-module inventory. Acceptance: define the neutral calculus and runtime identity model; assign ownership across locus, graph, image, surface, atlas, spatial, dataset, MVPA, connectivity, threshold, and latent; classify every overlapping abstraction as reuse, adapt, migrate, rename, compatibility-only, or intentionally domain-specific; define staged deliverables, dependencies, law gates, performance gates, and removals.
set.title: Locus 0: ratify ownership and duplicate-abstraction migration plan
